inputs.name: max_context_tokens
inputs.doc: Maximum tokens to retain in context window (default: 32000)

inputs.name: text
inputs.doc: The long text to summarize (markdown supported)

inputs.name: strategy
inputs.doc:
Summarization strategy:
• Refine — sequential, best coherence, no parallelism
• MapReduce — parallel chunking, fast, may lose cross-chunk context
• Hierarchical — structure-aware tree, best for headed documents
• Hybrid — MapReduce speed + Refine coherence polish
• SlidingWindow — fixed memory buffer, best for very long documents

inputs.name: densification
inputs.doc:
Post-processing to increase information density:
• None — use the strategy output as-is
• ChainOfDensity — iteratively compress to optimal density (~0.15 entities/token)

inputs.name: instructions
inputs.doc: Optional focus instructions (e.g. 'focus on action items', 'use bullet points')

inputs.name: prior_summary
inputs.doc: Optional existing summary to build upon (used as initial context for Refine/Hybrid/SlidingWindow strategies)

inputs.name: chunk_size
inputs.doc: Maximum characters per chunk. Reduce for models with smaller context windows (default: 8000)

inputs.name: chunk_overlap
inputs.doc: Overlap between adjacent chunks as percentage (0-50). Prevents information loss at boundaries (default: 10)

inputs.name: track_entities
inputs.doc: Extract and track named entities across chunks to prevent information loss. Adds 2-3 extra LLM calls but improves factual preservation.

inputs.name: concurrency
inputs.doc: Parallel requests for MapReduce/Hybrid strategies. 0 = unlimited, 1 = sequential (default: 4)

inputs.name: max_iterations
inputs.doc: Safety limit on summarization passes. Each pass reduces total length (default: 5)

inputs.name: density_steps
inputs.doc: Number of Chain of Density refinement steps when densification is enabled (1-5, default: 3). Research shows step 3 is the human-preferred sweet spot.

outputs.name: entities
outputs.doc: Tracked entities found in the document (only populated when Track Entities is enabled)

outputs.name: llm_calls
outputs.doc: Total number of LLM invocations used during summarization

signatures.doc: Summarizes long text using an LLM with configurable strategies. Supports Map-Reduce (parallel, fast), Refine (sequential, coherent), Hierarchical (structure-aware), Hybrid (parallel + coherent), and Sliding Window (memory-efficient). Optional Chain of Density post-processing for optimal information density.

inputs.name: strategy
inputs.doc:
Summarization strategy:
• Refine — sequential, best coherence, no parallelism
• MapReduce — parallel chunking, fast, may lose cross-chunk context
• Hierarchical — structure-aware tree, best for headed documents
• Hybrid — MapReduce speed + Refine coherence polish
• SlidingWindow — fixed memory buffer, best for very long documents

inputs.name: densification
inputs.doc:
Post-processing to increase information density:
• None — use the strategy output as-is
• ChainOfDensity — iteratively compress to optimal density

inputs.doc: Overlap between adjacent chunks as percentage (0-50). Prevents information loss at boundaries (default: 10).

inputs.name: track_entities
inputs.doc: Extract and track named entities across chunks to prevent information loss.

inputs.name: parallel_requests
inputs.doc: Number of chunks to process in parallel for MapReduce/Hybrid strategies. 0 = unlimited (default: 4).

inputs.name: density_steps
inputs.doc: Number of Chain of Density refinement steps when densification is enabled (1-5, default: 3).
